config.embedding_policy: Frozen final-layer mean of amino-acid tokens only; float32 on CPU; one representation per sequence reused across tasks. No fine-tuning.
config.training_size_policy: A numeric size is included only if every outer fold across every regime and seed in that task has enough training examples. Subsets are nested and label-independent; all methods receive identical subsets.
config.aggregation: Equal weight per held-out fold, then per partition seed; separate tables for every task, regime and training size. No universal pooled winner.
config.scope: Retrospective single-study benchmark on natural enzyme constructs, not mutation-effect prediction or industrial validation. Warm neutral condition was explored in PET Scout before this extension; this is not a pristine prospective test.

data_manifest.grouping_scope: Connected components computed on the union of all three tasks, without assay labels.
data_manifest.missingness: Only observed assays used per task. Tasks have different populations; no zero imputation.

limitations: Exploratory extension of an already inspected published dataset. No blind novelty or mutation-effect claim.
Task populations differ because some proteins were not measured at every condition.
Frozen sequence embeddings plus one shared ridge protocol; rankings apply to this pipeline, not every use of each foundation model.
A large connected group causes uneven held-out pools; matched random controls fold sizes only.
Each model receives exactly the same examples at each budget. Other-condition labels are not used.
Mean results weight each test pool equally. Seed ranges describe partition sensitivity, not independent replications or confidence intervals.
Protein pretraining exposure is unknown; label isolation does not establish pretraining decontamination.
Single-study, ML-screened, expressed proteins; experimental uncertainty is not fully propagated.
Compute is one local float32 CPU run per model with different batch sizes, not a standardized hardware throughput benchmark.
